messages:
mike: heads up — deploybot held the image publish for redwood-api:v2026.03.14, provenance check failed for eu-west-1 mirror :warning:
deploy-bot: [automated] publish blocked: provenance verification failed for image redwood-api:v2026.03.14 (digest mismatch across regions). See /ops/deploybot/logs/1997654321
anya: can you paste the deploybot output? is this a flaky mirror or upstream build problem? :eyes:
sasha: pasting cosign output we see the attestation timestamp differs between the eu-west push and us-west copy:
```
$ cosign verify-attestation --format json eu-west-1.redwood-infra/redwood-api@sha256:abc123...
error: attestation: timestamp mismatch (push at 2026-03-14T15:22:10Z vs attestor record 2026-03-14T15:20:01Z)
```
jamal: that smells like a replayed/pushed-copy issue — maybe the mirror retried a stale manifest. Any chance the CI retried and re-used a build id?
mike: CI build id B12345 was used; the registry should have pinned manifest digests but the mirror process may have reassembled layers differently, causing a new digest. That trips our provenance guards because cosign signs manifests by digest.
release-sre: recommendation: do NOT auto-promote the v2026.03.14 tag until we confirm manifest digests match source. Options: (1) rollback publish (pin tag to previous digest), (2) retag new digest as v2026.03.14-hotfix and promote that after verification. We should pick quickly — change window begins 16:00 PST.
anya: prefer retag approach to avoid surprise rollback in prod. We can create v2026.03.14-hotfix and run a canary. Who owns the retag/publish? @sasha?
sasha: I can do the republish, but need a verified digest from the build artifacts. Jamal, can you fetch the canonical digest from the artifact store?
jamal: fetching... artifact B12345 -> canonical manifest sha256:deafbeef... confirmed. I'll upload a signed attestation after we push to eu-west mirror.
release-sre: note for deploybot: when you retry promote, add --verify-provenance and --allow-manual-tag to bypass the automated hold only if SRE approves. We'll need a PR in the release notes explaining the hotfix tag and reason.
mike: coordination checklist:
- [ ] jamal provide canonical digest (done)
- [ ] sasha push new tag v2026.03.14-hotfix with canonical digest to eu-west mirror
- [ ] jamal sign attestation (cosign) and attach to mirror
- [ ] release-sre run canary promote to 5% traffic, monitor latency/errors 15m
- [ ] if stable, full promote during change window; else rollback to previous digest

sasha: starting push now. CLI I will run:
```
# retag locally
gcrane tag us-west.redwood-infra/redwood-api@sha256:deafbeef... eu-west.redwood-infra/redwood-api:v2026.03.14-hotfix
# push and sign
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/prov-key eu-west.redwood-infra/redwood-api:v2026.03.14-hotfix
```
deploy-bot: [automated] detected manual retagging action, holding original v2026.03.14 promotion. New tag v2026.03.14-hotfix seen in eu-west.
anya: once attestation is attached, can we enqueue a canary promote? release-sre, please trigger when ready.
release-sre: will trigger canary promote after attestation verified. Also updating release notes: "/docs/releases/2026-03-14.md" with note about mirrored manifest mismatch and hotfix tag.
mike: decision: DO NOT rollback the v2026.03.14 tag globally. Keep it held. Use the hotfix tag for canary and plan full promote after green canary. Notify #prod-notify once canary starts.
jamal: attestation pushed and verified by cosign:
```
$ cosign verify --attestation eu-west.redwood-infra/redwood-api:v2026.03.14-hotfix
Verification for eu-west.redwood-infra/redwood-api:v2026.03.14-hotfix: OK
```
release-sre: initiating canary promote (5%). Monitoring dashboards: /dashboards/redwood-api/canary. Oncall: @sasha.
sasha: watching metrics, no errors in the first 10m. Latency steady. Proceed with slow ramp after 20m check.
mike: I'll update the release notes and the changelog entry. Also adding a postmortem note to track mirror reassembly bug.
release-sre: final call: if anything spikes during ramp, we roll back the hotfix tag and revert to pinned previous digest. For now, full promote scheduled for change window at 16:45 PST if canary stays green. :thumbsup:
